title: Design System: TTS Built Client Portal

grid-head.note: Literal in app.css (jobs grid header, secondary button pressed); no custom property.

headline.purpose: Page title in the page bar and the sign-in heading; the ramp ceiling (20px).

title.purpose: Panel heads and empty-state titles (15px); shell company name and stat values at 650.

body.purpose: Grid cells, note text (max 70ch), detail values at 500. Root 14px desktop, 15px under 720px, 11pt print.

body-strong.purpose: Buttons, nav items, note authors; job numbers at 650 in link blue.

label.purpose: Field labels, grid column headings, tags, chips (13px 600); meta, hints, breadcrumbs, detail labels and counts at 400-500 in ink-3.

data.purpose: Tabular numerals for every date, time, count and job number.

mono.purpose: Webhook URLs and one-time secrets only.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: Panels, active side-nav item, photo tile hover.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: User drawer over a rgba(31,30,30,.45) scrim.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on all focusable elements; inset on top-nav links and grid sort headings.

shadows.name: viewer-image
shadows.purpose: Photo in the dark full-screen viewer only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow changes on buttons, inputs, nav and photo tiles.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Record and admin layouts to one column; detail grid two-up; side nav becomes a row.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: 15px root, icon-only shell nav, full-width page-bar actions and search fields, grid restacks into cards, photos two-up.

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.purpose: Completion record: shell and page bar hidden, dark logo, 2px brand rule, details two-column, notes then photos two-up.

narrative.overview:
The portal is a field-service work surface wearing TTS Built's own clothes. A near-black charcoal shell carries the real white-and-orange logo and the company block; under it a slim white page bar names the page, and below that sits a neutral, slightly cool grey workspace of white panels with tinted heads and cool hairlines. Everything a client needs to confirm work was done (dates, job numbers, notes, photos) is set in one workhorse system sans with tabular numerals, so the record reads like a dependable trade document rather than a dashboard.

Density is deliberately that of the category software users already know (AroFlo, Simpro), which the user chose over an earlier, roomier, warmer version: a 14px root, 36px controls, 44px panel heads, 16px panel padding, flat zebra-striped data grids with sortable column headings, and a 1400px page. It is played straight and kept tidy rather than restyled. Orange is the brand's voice but is spent sparingly: the 3px active rule under the current nav item, the one primary action, selection, sort direction and focus. Blue means "go to": links, breadcrumbs and job numbers.

The record must survive paper. The job page prints as an A4 completion record: chrome and page bar removed, dark logo, a 2px brand-orange rule, the job details as a two-column list, notes, then photos two-up.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal shell, white page bar, cool grey ground, white panels with tinted heads.
Compact, AroFlo-style density: 14px root, 36px controls, 44px panel heads.
Two oranges with separate jobs: bright for marks, deep for text and actions.
Blue reserved for links, breadcrumbs and job numbers.
One system sans, tabular numerals for every date, count and job number.
Lucide line icons at 2px stroke, 14 to 18px, coloured in ink-3 beside text.
Flat surfaces with one subtle shadow; heavy shadow only on overlays.
Prints to a clean A4 report.

rules.name: The Two Oranges Rule
rules.body: Bright TTS orange is a mark (rules, underlines, logo); deep orange is for anything read or pressed. If it is text, a fill behind text, or a focus ring, it is the deep orange.

rules.name: The Blue Means Go-To Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only on things that navigate: links, breadcrumbs and job numbers. Orange never marks a link, blue never marks an action.

rules.name: The Shell Stays Up Top Rule
rules.body: Charcoal belongs to the top bar (and the dark photo viewer). The workspace stays cool and light; no dark cards or dark sections inside it.

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: Workspace greys are neutral to slightly cool (blue-grey undertone). Warm beiges and taupes are retired; the only warmth on the page comes from the two oranges.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, count and job number is set with tabular numerals, so columns of records align and compare at a glance.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: The ramp tops out at 20px. New screens add emphasis with 600 weight and ink level, not with larger type.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a 1px cool line before it is lifted by a shadow. Shadows stronger than Subtle appear only on overlays.

dos: **Do** keep bright TTS orange to marks (3px nav underline, 2px print rule, logo) and use deep orange for every orange text, fill and focus ring.
**Do** set dates, times, counts and job numbers in tabular numerals, and job numbers in blue at 650.
**Do** keep the compact density: 36px controls (30px small), 44px panel heads on the panel tint, 16px panel bodies, 8px by 14px grid cells.
**Do** put the page title, breadcrumb and page actions in the page bar, not inside the page column.
**Do** separate surfaces with a 1px cool hairline and the Subtle shadow; reserve the Overlay shadow for drawers.
**Do** use Lucide line icons at 2px stroke (18px default, 16px in inputs and tallies, 14px in breadcrumbs), coloured ink-3 beside text.
**Do** keep one primary orange button per view and make it the job's main outcome.
**Do** hide sections and cells that have nothing in them rather than showing dashes or "none".
**Do** check every new record layout in print: chrome and page bar hidden, notes and photos unbroken, logo and brand rule on top.
**Do** keep text at ink-3 or darker; zero and meta states use ink-3, not a lighter grey.
donts: **Don't** set the bright #ff4616 orange as text or as a fill behind text on white.
**Don't** colour links orange or actions blue.
**Don't** introduce a second display or text typeface; mono is only for secrets and URLs to copy.
**Don't** raise the type ramp above 20px to add emphasis.
**Don't** reintroduce warm beige or taupe greys into the workspace.
**Don't** bring charcoal into the workspace as dark cards or dark sections.
**Don't** put counts in pills or badges; they are muted parenthesised text.
**Don't** mix icon sets, filled icons or text glyphs in place of icons.
**Don't** use heavy or hard offset shadows on resting panels.
**Don't** add small caption labels above page or panel headings; the "Client Portal" caption is part of the shell's company block only, and the page-bar breadcrumb is navigation, not a label.
